summary: Frontend-only regression after main agent added <style id='seduc-mobile-header'> mobile override in termos.html and inicio.html. All critical test cases PASS. Mobile 390x844 /termos.html shows exactly ONE visible CEV logo (img.cc-logo-internal 163x48 at top=24) with no horizontal overflow, green/yellow wave header rendering correctly, and page header logo now visible on mobile (previously hidden). Mobile /inicio.html shows the header logo + modal logo while the Aviso modal is open (2 CEV logos as expected), then 1 after clicking data-testid=modal-aviso-ok-btn. Mobile checkbox flow verified: data-testid=termos-checkbox enables data-testid=btn-continuar-termos (disabled=True -> False) and clicking it navigates to /inscricao.html. Mobile data-testid=btn-inscricao-online clicked and navigates to /termos.html after loader. Desktop 1920x800 regression on /termos.html confirms 1 CEV logo (237x70) plus top utility bar container (header.cc-header > .container-fluid first child) visible and populated (PORTAL DA UECE/CEV, flags, OUVIDORIA..., search, INÍCIO/CONCURSOS). Desktop /inicio.html shows 2 CEV logos before modal close, 1 after. Regression on /inscricao.html, /dados-inscricao.html, /confirmacao, /pagamento-pix, /inscricao-realizada, /minhas-inscricoes.html visually confirmed via screenshots - each shows exactly ONE CEV logo in the header on both mobile and desktop (no duplicate card logos). No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: The <style id='seduc-mobile-header'> block is a targeted mobile-only patch (max-width:767px) that correctly: (a) re-displays the header previously hidden by the site's responsive CSS via .d-none.d-md-block, (b) scales down logo height to 48px, (c) hides topbar container-fluid and non-logo nav items on mobile, (d) removes body padding-top. This is a reasonable minimally-invasive fix. Consider extracting these inline mobile overrides into a dedicated CSS file (e.g. /app/frontend/public/css/mobile-header.css) if more pages need the same fix - current approach duplicates the <style> block in two HTML files which violates DRY.

Logo detection on React SPA pages (/inscricao.html, /dados-inscricao.html, /confirmacao, /pagamento-pix, /inscricao-realizada, /minhas-inscricoes.html) could not programmatically find tags with CEV identifiers (likely using without alt/class or background-images). Visual verification via screenshots confirms single header logo on each, but adding data-testid='header-logo' to the logo element on these pages would make future automated checks reliable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile header duplicate-logo fix fully verified. The <style id='seduc-mobile-header'> media query (max-width:767px) in termos.html and inicio.html correctly restores the single header logo on mobile. Automated img.cc-logo-internal count = 1 on mobile for both pages; before closing modal on inicio there are 2 CEV logos (header + modal) which is expected. Flows (checkbox->continuar, btn-inscricao-online->termos) work. Desktop regressions intact. Only minor improvement: extract duplicated mobile <style> block into a shared CSS file.
